notes: Custom token launch of IMD (IMD), src/IMD.sol:IMD, a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin ERC20 with no overrides. The constructor takes no arguments and mints exactly 1,000,000,000 * 10^18 = 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units (18 decimals) once to msg.sender, which under ProjectFactory.launchCustom is the factory; token.totalSupply states that amount. No application contracts are deployed: contracts is empty and there are no initialization calls. The token has no owner, minter, pause, blacklist, freeze, burnFrom, seize, proxy or upgrade path, no transfer fee or burn on transfer, and its runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT, so the factory transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the pool seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager, the remainder forward and trader swaps all move exactly the stated amounts without any exemption. Pool: paired with native ETH (the zero address), fee 3000 (0.3%) with tickSpacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: with ETH as currency0 and IMD as currency1, the opening cap of 1 ETH (economics.initialMarketCapWei) over the full supply gives 10^9 minor units of IMD per wei, so sqrtPriceX96 = sqrt(10^9) * 2^96 = 2505414483750479311864138015696063; the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply. economics is copied verbatim from the job: poolBps 8800 of the supply seeds the single-sided pool and the rest of the requester's share goes to remainderTo. The swarm's 1000 bps is taken by the factory by construction and is not written here.
